title: El bote de las luces: el cielo de las ánimas
description: docs/animas/README.md § The jar, src/jar-ui.ts. The jar at home opens as a window over the living room: one sky with a constellation per ánima, folded small and scattered until a player opens it onto their side and works inside; the jar below with every eco. Lights fly from the jar to the node they turn on and back; Gerard and Aitor each have their own cursor and floating note. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: localStorage.removeItem('gerard35.ecos.v1'); window.gerard.story.clearImprovements(); window.gerard.story.debugEcos = 14; window.jar = window.gerard.jarUI; window.node = id => document.querySelector(`[data-improve="${id}"]`)

steps.caption: The jar on the dining table and the prompt Abrir el bote
Opening: the window rises out of the jar over the living room (it never takes the whole screen)

The sky, every constellation folded: each ánima's own tree, joins and all, small and soft, scattered over the sky (never a row: nothing says how many there will be), its name under it; the jar below with the ecos. Gerard points at his: it comes into focus and its name is underlined in gold
Gerard opens Matemágico: it leaves its place in the sky for his side, growing and sharpening, each ring of nodes coming up after the one before
Matemágico unfolded: Cálculo, Fuego, Eléctrico, Agua and the definitiva asleep. He now moves only inside it
On a node: the floating note says what it is, what it does, what it costs and what pressing would do
Turning a node on: a light leaves the jar, crosses the sky and lands; the node becomes a pane of lit glass, a ring runs out of it and its join lights
Player 2 touches the pad: Aitor comes in pointing at Tecnópata (its name underlined in cyan), still folded, while Gerard works inside Matemágico
Aitor opens his own onto the right side: each player in a different constellation at once
Both unfolded, both at work: Gerard electricity as far as Descarga, Aitor Mente whole. Two notes, each edged in its player's colour and threaded to its node
More lights in: lit nodes are flat panes of glass in their line's colour, a passive a rounded square; the jar keeps every eco, the ones in an ánima dark and tinted by where they went
Gerard steps back out: Matemágico shrinks back to its place in the sky; what is lit stays brighter in the small tree
The sky again, both folded: each small constellation shows its lit stars and lit joins
Turning Atacar · Agua off takes everything after it on its line too: each light flies back to the jar, nothing is lost
Closing: the window folds back down into the jar and the room is theirs again
The status screen's Ánimas page: Matemágico shows no level, its bought skills in the list and its passives under Con ecos de luz
